name: Orb-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The ring is at its brightest and most rippled here, with a hot highlight on the upper rim.

tagline: A thin glowing ring of red and green light pulses on black.
summary: A fuzzy ring of coloured light hovers on black, its rim shading from yellow-green to magenta. The edge wobbles and swirls while it turns, brighter under the pointer.
appearance: A hollow circular ring of soft neon glow, roughly the size of a coin on a black stage. The rim runs from yellow-green through pink to red and fades into a blurry halo, with the centre left dark.
behaviour: The rim ripples slowly and a bright bead of light travels around it. Hovering the middle makes the edge undulate and the whole ring rotates, settling when the pointer leaves.
search_phrases: neon ring that reacts to hover
use_when: A dark hero or loader area needs one small glowing focal object with colour.
avoid_when: You want a solid sphere: the shader draws a ring with a dark, see-through middle.
customise: Hue, hover distortion strength, whether it rotates on hover, a forced hover state and the background colour are props. Ring size and noise are fixed constants.
weight_why: A full-screen shader evaluates 3D simplex noise for every pixel each frame.

a11y.note: Decorative and hover-driven, with no keyboard equivalent and no reduced-motion check.

issues: The orb reads as a hollow ring rather than a filled sphere, since the centre stays dark.
polish_why: A clean neon glow, but simple and the empty middle weakens the orb idea.
title: Orb
